notes.title: Patch 0.28 – Steam Deck Fix & Even Easier Fights!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released Patch 0.28, and here’s what’s new:

[h2]🔧Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Steam Deck Fix – We resolved a video rendering issue that made the game unplayable on Steam Deck. Now, you can enjoy the game smoothly on the go!
[*]Even Easier Fights – We’ve adjusted combat difficulty (again!) based on your feedback, making battles even more accessible.
[/list]

[h2]🔜 Coming Next[/h2]
While the game is already fully playable with an Xbox controller, we’re working on making controller support more robust. The next update will ensure that the UI properly adapts to the input system you’re using, making for a smoother experience across all control methods.

As always, thanks for your support, and let us know what you think! 🚀

notes.title: Patch 0.27
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Update – Small Tweaks![/h1]

Thank you for all the amazing feedback—you’re helping make the game even better!

Here’s what’s new in today’s update:

[list]
[*] [b]Fairer Fights[/b] – Knocking out a crocodile now fully restores your stamina, making battles a little less grueling.
[*] [b]Safer Graphics Changes[/b] – Adjusting quality settings is now more foolproof. If you select High Quality (which requires more GPU and memory), we’ll ask for confirmation before applying the change.
[/list]


More improvements are on the way—stay tuned!

notes.title: Release Date on 24th January 2025
notes.notes:
[b]Cat Detective Albert Wilde[/b]'s release date on Steam is [b]January 24, 2025.[/b]

We are excited to announce the release date for our eccentric mystery adventure Cat Detective Albert Wilde, alongside a release date announcement trailer. 

Cat Detective Albert Wilde is a comedy noir, sci - fi mystery game that blends elements of a walking simulator and interactive novel, with a strong focus on humor. 

About the game
A freakish corpse… a pissed-off bookie… a wormhole to another reality… it’s just another day in the office for Albert Wilde, feline private eye. Cat Detective Albert Wilde is a short (6-7 hour runtime) genre-bending adventure set in 1930’s New York, featuring atmospheric visuals, neat minigames, and at least one joke about cat nipples (they have six!). Players must talk, walk and puzzle their way through a murder mystery that’s messier than a fresh hairball, in this hilarious zoological tribute to the golden age of noir.

notes.title: Dev Update - Changelog Clues
notes.notes:
[h1][b]It's finally weekend Detectives![/b][/h1]

But crime does not sleep, nor does finding clues in our changelog...

We have updated the following through your feedback transcriptions, where we improve accessibility, UI/UX and more!

[h2]Where can you Find Albert?[/h2]
We have added our Steam Wishlist, Discord and Twitter links to the game. There will be a notification to wishlist the game upon entering the office and instead of the demo closing down at the end it will ask you to both wishlist and join us over at our Discord as this is very important for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/514fe777b8bf0843c1924f4edeb3b07b73befe6a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Where am I? [/h2]
We have improved the map UI/UX to an extent where you can now see at which location you are, taking away confusion to why you can't fast travel to the market for some milk, while you're already there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/bd0f66f3d9d5e3e688b64ebe208e5b8eb05a6a15.png[/img]

[h2]What's in the bag!?[/h2]
We have fixed a bug where your last inventory item icon would be a wrong icon. 

[h2]Main Menu[/h2]
Mouse input now works to select the buttons in the main menu, where before you could only select these with your arrow keys.

[h2]Game States[/h2]
We have resolved conflicts with different game states by defining transitions rules among the game modes (loading, game, main menu, whishlist menu) e.g. if the map is open and you enter the main menu, the input will not affect the underly map selections.

notes.title: Game Update - Putting the 'Quantum' in Quantum P.I.
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there, [/h2]

It's that time again when we drop by to let you know how things are going behind the scenes for [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. [/b]!

[b][h3]Putting the 'Quantum' in Quantum P.I.[/h3][/b]
We've been working on some of the more science-fiction elements of Albert Wilde recently, getting stuck in with all things multiversal and timey-wimey. 

Looking into concepts behind alternate reality theories and special and general relativity has been really interesting, but they're certainly not the easiest things to wrap your head around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/7ad45685702b8802498a49ad0b63c5a3db5c8d01.jpg[/img]

Consistency and challenge are two important aspects that have to be considered when playing around with these aspects of the sci-fi genre, so lots of research and testing has been involved.

Unsurprisingly, this hasn't been the fastest process for us but we're excited about how it's all coming together and can't wait for you to see how it all ties in with [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. [/b]!

Oh, and of course we had to design [redacted], which maybe you'll get to uncover in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/65d79198b4c65a0ff2d1f6c52aad1bcf47846b72.gif[/img]

And that's that! A lot of work is going on behind the curtains for our kooky cat caper, [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I.[/b] but we want to keep some of it under wraps for now. 

Thanks so much for your support, we'll be calling on you detectives soon! 

~ Maria and Andreas, [i]beyondthosehills[/i] 🐱

notes.title: Dev Update - Cabins, Construction, and Closing chapters 🐈
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there, [/h2]

We're just stopping by to give you a very quick rundown on what's going on behind the scenes for [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. [/b]!

We are so grateful for everyone who's checked out the game or given it a wishlist, so the least we can do is keep you updated. Let's have a look then, shall we?

[h3][b]The Cabin in the Woods[/b][/h3]
We've been designing and implementing a forest environment where, with a bit of exploration, you might even find a secluded cabin. This area is still in progress. Our plan is to add some more elements, flesh out the details of the surroundings, and create some different iterations of the forest and cabin that will depend on the puzzles you'll need to solve to investigate the area! But so far, we think it looks pretty good (and pretty mysterious too)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/a6ab0eaf6bf3c0543069141f4f2889decfc28214.png[/img]

[h3][b]The Final Chapter[/b][/h3]
Reworking the final part of the narrative has been a focus of ours since the demo left Steam and, although we're keeping our cards close to our chest when it comes to the actual story, we're pleased to say that this final chapter has now been finalised and is ready for development!

[h3][b]City Construction[/b][/h3]
And finally, we've been expanding the city with some interior spaces! Three brand new city apartments have been under construction and who knows, maybe you'll be visiting them for interrogations, interviews, or even to find informants 👀 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/2304ebaed39baf2f41bded2843607e6bdada385d.gif[/img]

And that's all for now! This is only a glimpse of what's happening on the other side of the screen for [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I.[/b] but we hope you've enjoyed the insight.

Thanks so much for your support, we'll be calling on you detectives soon! 

~ Maria and Andreas, [i]beyondthosehills[/i] 🐱
